phrases: Does cracking your knuckles give you arthritis?
Your finger joints are wrapped in a capsule of slippery fluid,
and a bubble of gas forms.
That's why you can't crack the same knuckle again right away.
You have to wait about twenty minutes.
One doctor, Donald Unger, cracked the knuckles of his left hand for more than fifty years,
He won an Ig Nobel Prize for it.
